commons-beni-hassan-18.title: Painted registers
commons-beni-hassan-18.text: Follow the small figures and horizontal bands on the back wall. Compare their edges with the mottled surface between them.

commons-beni-hassan-18.title: Light and shadow
commons-beni-hassan-18.text: The bottom of the photograph is brightly lit. Fit above the glare before deciding whether a newly separated patch follows a painted form.

commons-beni-hassan-19.title: Figures in rows
commons-beni-hassan-19.text: Look at the repeated dark figures near the top. A useful comparison keeps their outlines visible in the original as well as in false color.

commons-beni-hassan-19.title: Faded bands
commons-beni-hassan-19.text: Study the narrow vertical bands in the middle, away from the bright lower edge. Color differences can arise from both paint and uneven illumination.

commons-oplontis-wall-2.title: A delicate central motif
commons-oplontis-wall-2.text: Follow the thin painted lines around the central upright motif. Compare their continuity across worn patches.

commons-oplontis-wall-2.title: Decoration and surface loss
commons-oplontis-wall-2.text: The right-hand rectangular ornament sits among pale losses and mottling. Check whether a color boundary follows the design or the damaged plaster.

commons-herculaneum-telephus.title: Face and garment
commons-herculaneum-telephus.text: Inspect the seated figure on the left and the folds below it. The museum photograph records both surviving paint and the present restored surface.

commons-herculaneum-telephus.title: A painted border
commons-herculaneum-telephus.text: The narrow edge separates the picture from its display. Fit inside the painted scene so the frame does not drive the color calculation.

commons-stabiae-flora.title: The pale garment
commons-stabiae-flora.text: Compare the yellow and pale folds against the green ground. The change in contrast may make their boundaries easier to follow.

commons-stabiae-flora.title: Flowers and losses
commons-stabiae-flora.text: Small light marks appear near the extended hand and along the right edge. Compare them with exposed plaster before interpreting each mark as a flower.

commons-mari-investiture-1.title: Surviving painted scenes
commons-mari-investiture-1.text: Start with the lower central register, where figures and vertical elements remain. The large pale losses above contain no missing image that this transform can recover.

commons-mari-investiture-1.title: Reflections across the surface
commons-mari-investiture-1.text: The broad bright patch at the left changes the photographed colors. Compare another view of the same panel in the related-view group.

commons-erebuni-fragment-2.title: Within the frame
commons-erebuni-fragment-2.text: Fit to the blue and gray painted fragment, excluding the shiny frame and neighboring loose fragment.

commons-erebuni-fragment-2.title: Cracks across color
commons-erebuni-fragment-2.text: A dark crack crosses the middle. Check it in the original: an amplified line is not automatically part of the painted design.

commons-dunhuang-vaishravana.title: Waves above the figures
commons-dunhuang-vaishravana.text: Thin curved lines describe water across the upper half. Inspect them against the visible texture of the silk.

commons-dunhuang-vaishravana.title: Clouds and garments
commons-dunhuang-vaishravana.text: Compare the blue, red and green passages around the central standing figure. This studies recorded color differences, not the identity of the colorants.

commons-faras-archangel.title: Repeated ornament
commons-faras-archangel.text: The surviving patterned garment contains small repeated forms. Compare the same form in a strong and a worn passage.

commons-faras-archangel.title: A broken edge
commons-faras-archangel.text: The large pale area to the right interrupts the painted fragment. Enhancement can outline the surviving edge but cannot reconstruct the missing figure.

commons-pazyryk-carpet.title: Border figures
commons-pazyryk-carpet.text: Follow the small repeated figures in the lower border. Inspect the weave and worn passages at native size.

commons-pazyryk-carpet.title: Central rosettes
commons-pazyryk-carpet.text: Compare adjacent squares in the center. Uneven wear and the photograph’s strong color rendition remain part of the comparison.

commons-angkor-style-deity.title: Surviving later lacquer
commons-angkor-style-deity.text: The red coating on the torso is described as later than the sculpture. Stronger separation does not date that coating.

commons-angkor-style-deity.title: Patterns on the skirt
commons-angkor-style-deity.text: Follow the narrow vertical ornament on the skirt, avoiding the bright reflection and surrounding display.

commons-oplontis-bird.title: The bird’s body
commons-oplontis-bird.text: Compare the warm body and darker folded wing. The faint outlines remain part of the same photographed surface.

commons-oplontis-bird.title: Ground and plaster
commons-oplontis-bird.text: Study the thin ground line under the bird against nearby mottled plaster. False color can emphasize both.

commons-nefertari-68.title: Painted stars
commons-nefertari-68.text: Compare stars across the darker ceiling. Changes in illumination can alter their contrast without reflecting different pigments.

commons-nefertari-68.title: Animals and fine lines
commons-nefertari-68.text: Inspect the lower row of animals and nearby inscriptions. Keep the original beside the enhancement when following a delicate line.

commons-durrow-125v.title: Interlaced ribbons
commons-durrow-125v.text: Follow one colored ribbon across the center. Compare overlapping colored bands with the lighter parchment around them.

commons-durrow-125v.title: A worn border
commons-durrow-125v.text: Inspect the painted lower border and the plain margin. Printing, scanning and the parchment surface can all affect recorded color.

commons-tonga-ngatu.title: A crown on barkcloth
commons-tonga-ngatu.text: Follow the crown and its surrounding leaves. The photograph shows a historic textile and the lighting of its display.

commons-tonga-ngatu.title: Creases and painted marks
commons-tonga-ngatu.text: Compare the lower-left lettering with the cloth’s creases. Both can become more conspicuous after color separation.

commons-castelseprio-joseph.title: A face above the folds
commons-castelseprio-joseph.text: Inspect the small face in the upper center and the garment beside it. The surface is worn; avoid filling in forms that are absent from the photograph.

commons-castelseprio-joseph.title: A surviving hand
commons-castelseprio-joseph.text: Compare the outlined hand and the garment below it with the broad faded ground at the right.
